note: Reviewed for E5.4 against boss_mograine_and_whitemane.cpp, eventai/sm-cathedral.ts and acid_classic.sql. Fairbanks is single-target plus a 5 yd sleep the melee are standing in. The pair is the one ordering fight in Scarlet Monastery: the resurrection puts a full-health Mograine back on the floor while Whitemane is still up at half, and the kill-order row names her first.

bosses.name: High Inquisitor Fairbanks
bosses.cite: eventai/sm-cathedral.ts:454201-454206, acid_classic.sql:16009-16014 creature_id=4542 - and the file's own header at :16008 marks the Sleep and Fear rows as reconstruction, 'NEED MORE DATA (No Official Sleep or Fear Data)'. Sleep 8399 is the only area effect he has: targetA 22 then 15, radiusYd 5.0, aura 12 mechanic 10 for 10 s on a flat 30 s timer - a disc inside melee reach, so clearing it means not meleeing him, and the ranged stand at DEFAULT_OPEN_YD 18 (combatGeometry.ts:66) is already outside it. Curse of Blood 8282 (aura 14, dispel 2), Dispel Magic 15090 and Fear 12096 (aura 7, mechanic 5, 8 s) are all single-target, and Heal 12039 at <=30% with Power Word: Shield 11647 at <=25% are self-rescue an interrupt or a purge answers from the class rotation.

bosses.name: Scarlet Commander Mograine & High Inquisitor Whitemane
bosses.cite: boss_mograine_and_whitemane.cpp:44-56 both kits; acid_classic.sql:15902-15903 hands 3976 and 3977 to the two cpp scripts. Deep Sleep 9256 is targetA 22 then 15 with radiusYd 100.0, aura 12 for 10 s - a hundred-yard disc is the whole cathedral, so no position verb touches it, and Dominate Mind 14515 (aura 6, mechanic 1, 15 s on a random player) is a dispel. What the fight really asks is an order, because the resurrection leaves two bodies up at once.

encounterRows.label: Whitemane first once Mograine is back up
encounterRows.cite: The resurrection is degraded to three waves in this tree: 3976 alone, then 3977 alone, then a fresh 3976 injected while Whitemane is STILL ALIVE (sm-cathedral.ts:154-158 SM_MOGRAINE_WHITEMANE.waves, liveGauntletEscort.ts:608-656, :651 'final wave - Mograine inject; Whitemane stays in spawned'). The inject is gated on Whitemane at or below 50% HP with Mograine already down (canScarletResurrect, sm-cathedral.ts:167-176; cpp:477 GetHealthPercent() <= 50.0f), so the both-up phase always opens with Mograine at full and Whitemane at half. She is the body to finish: Heal 12039 for 589 every 13 s, Power Word: Shield 22187 for 205 absorb every 22-45 s, Holy Smite 9481 for 134 every 2-3 s, and Dominate Mind 14515 charming a raider for 15 s every 20-30 s once the res phase is armed (scarletMonastery.ts:658-672). kill_order is a filter and does not win the GCD (types.ts:366-375), and raidEncounterTactics.ts:174-180 registers the rule under 3977 as well as 3976, so it keeps holding while the focus is Whitemane. In wave 0 there is no 3977 alive and the row falls straight through to Mograine.

encounterRows.label: Casters hold while the Divine Shield is up
encounterRows.cite: Divine Shield 1020, mechanic 25 invulnerability for 12 s in his baked kit (creature_template_spells 3976 spell3; 642 for 10 s in boss_mograine_and_whitemane.cpp), fired once at <=50% HP and then disabled (cpp:301-307 DisableCombatAction; scarletMonastery.ts:525-545 MOGRAINE_PHASE_SHIELD). Wave 0 is Mograine ALONE (sm-cathedral.ts:154-158 waves), so the shield eats the whole party's damage and mana for its full duration with nothing else to hit. This row was blocked until 2026-08-27 because halt_dps was scoped by SCHOOL only, so arming it in the both-up wave stopped damage on Whitemane too - the body the kill-order row above just named. `entries` closes that: the halt refuses a cast only when the unit's current target is 3976 (rotation/types.ts halt_dps `entries`; haltDpsCoversEntry in rotation/evaluate.ts). PHYSICAL is deliberately NOT in the school list. A halt that also stops white swings takes the tank's threat and the combat flag off the boss for twelve seconds, which is the Mandokir shape stepSession.ts:2278 records as a 1,800,100 ms stalemate. Melee keep swinging and holding him; the casters stop paying mana into an invulnerable body, which is what the window actually costs.
